closed: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: full-frame blink texture for an existing 2D animated character. Image 1 is the edit target, a 1254×1254 transparent PNG. Image 2 is a region map: ONLY the two RED regions identify editable eye areas; it is not an output background. Edit image 1: close BOTH eyes in a relaxed natural blink. Draw one elegant, thin, gently downward-curving upper lash line per eye, with small tapered outer lashes. Keep the original eye corners and perspective, shallow curves rather than deep U shapes. No iris or eye whites should remain. Replace the original raised upper lashes and crease remnants with clean matching skin; avoid double lash lines, thick black wedges, lower-eye bags, or extra wrinkles. Preserve eyebrows, hair that overlaps the eyes, skin shading, cheeks, nose and smile exactly. All other pixels, head pose, scale, character placement, clothing, ears and tail MUST match image 1. Return the complete square character image with the SAME framing, not a crop. Transparent background, no text, no marks. This will be registered to the original image: do not shift or rescale the subject.
half: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: full-frame half-blink texture for an existing 2D animated character. Image 1 is the edit target, a 1254×1254 transparent PNG. Image 2 is a region map: ONLY the two RED regions identify editable eye areas; it is not an output background. Edit image 1: lower BOTH upper eyelids halfway down for the middle frame of a gentle natural blink. Keep about 45 percent of each original eye opening visible, the original blue iris visible only below the upper lid, same forward gaze. Draw a refined tapered upper eyelash line consistent with the original style, not an angry squint. Fill above the lowered lash with matching skin and remove any original upper lash/crease ghost so there is no doubled outline. Preserve eye corners, lower lid, eyebrows, original perspective, hair overlapping the eyes, cheek color, nose and smile. All other pixels, head pose, scale, character placement, clothing, ears and tail MUST match image 1. Return the complete square character image with the SAME framing, not a crop. Transparent background, no text, no marks. This will be registered to the original: do not shift or rescale the subject.
tail: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: separate transparent tail layer for a 2D character animation rig. The reference image is the original character. Return ONLY her blue aquatic shark/dolphin tail, in exactly its original size, position and orientation on the SAME square 1254×1254 transparent canvas. Erase the entire girl, face, hair, ears, clothes, hands and all other content. KEEP the tail at the right of the canvas: its two pointed blue flukes start around (875,505) and (1140,410), its curved blue tail shaft runs down the right side and curves toward its root around (930,1178). Preserve the original blue gradient, white oval highlights, delicate dark blue linework and cel-painted illustration style. Reconstruct the small parts of the tail that were hidden behind her hair, so the tail has a clean continuous silhouette, particularly the curving root at the bottom and the left edge of its shaft. The root may extend left behind the body to (850,1178). Do NOT center the tail, zoom it, resize it or alter its silhouette. This is a precise registered animation layer; the empty left two thirds of the canvas must remain genuinely transparent. No character, hair strands, text, grid, shadow, checkerboard or additional objects. Full square RGBA PNG with alpha.
body: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: original character body layer without tail, for 2D animation. Edit the provided 1254×1254 square image: remove ONLY the large blue aquatic tail on the RIGHT, including both forked flukes and the curved shaft down to the lower right. The former tail region must become genuinely transparent. Preserve the ENTIRE girl including all long blue hair curls on her right side, face, OPEN blue eyes, ears, maid outfit, both hands, pose, scale and placement EXACTLY. Where the tail previously overlapped her hair, recover the natural fine edge of the hair with no tail-colored scraps, preserving the existing hair strand silhouette. Do not remove her hair or shrink its volume. Every part of her stays in the same original pixel coordinates; no recentering, reframing, rescaling, expression changes or redraw of her face. Keep original drawing style and shading. Return the complete square canvas with transparent background; no tail, no text, no shadow, no checkerboard.
